HomePage.introText1: InstaView Stories kyauta ne, wani Mai Kallon Labarun Instagram wanda ke taimaka maka bincika abun ciki na Instagram da ake samu ba tare da shiga asusu ba. Shigar da sunan mai amfani ko hanyar bayanin martaba na Instagram don duba Labarai da ake samu, bincika bayanin martaba, da kuma bincika hotuna, bidiyo, Reels, da Fitattun Labarun Instagram.
HomePage.introText2: Hakanan za ka iya amfani da InstaView Stories don neman sakwanni, duba hotunan bayanin martaba, da samun takamaiman abun ciki ta hanyar shigar da hanyar sako ko reel na Instagram da ake tallafawa sannan ka sauke da danna sau ɗaya a kowace na'ura. An tsara wannan kayan aiki don sauƙin bincike mai dacewa, ba tare da buƙatar yin rajista, kalmar sirrin Instagram, ko bayanan sirri ba.
HomePage.introText3: Ko kana son duba Labarun Instagram a asirce, bincika bayanin martabar mai amfani, bincika Fitattun Labarun Instagram, ko neman wani hoto, bidiyo, ko reel na musamman, InstaView Stories ya haɗa waɗannan fasalulluka tare a cikin Mai Kallon Bayanin Martaba da Mai Kallon Labarai na Instagram mai sauƙin amfani.
HomePage.featuresIntro: Bincika abun ciki na Instagram da ake iya gani ga kowa tare da InstaView Stories. Duba Labarai, bayanan martaba, sakwanni, Fitattun Labarai, hotuna, bidiyo, da Reels na jama'a ta hanyar kayan aiki guda mai sauƙi kuma mai saurin amfani.
HomePage.featureCard1Text: Shigar da sunan mai amfani na Instagram na jama'a ko hanyar bayanin martaba don bincika Labarun Instagram da ake samu. Mai Kallon Labarun Instagram namu na kyauta yana sauƙaƙa gano abun cikin Labarai na jama'a ba tare da shiga asusu ba.
HomePage.featureCard2Title: Mai Kallon Bayanin Martaba na Instagram
HomePage.featureCard2Text: Duba bayanin martaba na jama'a da ake samu, wanda ya haɗa da bio, masu bi, wanda ake bi, sakwanni, da bayanan alamar tabbatarwa. Yi amfani da InstaView Stories a matsayin Mai Kallon Bayanin Martaba na Instagram mai sauƙi don bincika asusun jama'a a wuri guda.
HomePage.featureCard3Text: Bincika hotuna da bidiyo da bayanan martaba na jama'a na Instagram suka raba. Bincika sakwannin Instagram da ake samu ta hanyar allon amfani mai tsafta kuma mai sauƙi ba tare da yawo cikin tsari mai rikitarwa ba.
HomePage.featureCard4Text: Bincika Fitattun Labarun Instagram da ake samu daga bayanan martaba na jama'a. Mai Kallon Fitattun Labarun Instagram namu yana taimaka maka gano Labaran da aka ajiye da kuma bincika abun cikin Fitattun Labarai na jama'a a wuri guda.
HomePage.featureCard5Text: Ajiye hotuna da bidiyon Labarun Instagram na jama'a da ake samu idan zaɓin saukewa yana tallafawa. Mai Saukar Labarun Instagram yana ba da hanya mai dacewa don samun abun cikin Labarai da ake tallafawa.
HomePage.featureCard6Text: Sauke Fitattun Labarun Instagram na jama'a da ake samu idan ana tallafawa. Yi amfani da Mai Saukar Fitattun Labarun Instagram don ajiye hotuna da bidiyon Fitattun Labarai da ake tallafawa domin dubawa daga baya.
HomePage.featureCard7Text: Duba da ajiye hotunan da ake samu daga sakwannin Instagram na jama'a. Mai Saukar Hotunan Instagram namu yana ba da zaɓin saukewa mai sauƙi don abun cikin hoto na jama'a da ake tallafawa.
HomePage.featureCard8Text: Sami bidiyon da ake samu daga sakwanni da bayanan martaba na Instagram na jama'a. Sauke bidiyon Instagram na jama'a da ake tallafawa ta hanyar tsari mai sauƙi kuma mai dacewa.
HomePage.featureCard9Text: Bincika kuma sauke Reels na Instagram na jama'a da ake samu idan ana tallafawa. Mai Saukar Reels na Instagram yana sauƙaƙa samun bidiyon reel da ake tallafawa daga bayanan martaba na jama'a ko hanyoyin sako kai tsaye.
HomePage.featureCard10Title: Mai Saukar Hoton Bayanin Martaba na Instagram
HomePage.featureCard10Text: Duba hotunan bayanin martaba da ake samu daga asusun Instagram na jama'a sannan ka sauke su idan ana tallafawa. Mai Saukar Hoton Bayanin Martaba na Instagram yana ba da hanya mai sauƙi don samun hotunan bayanin martaba na jama'a.

HomePage.faq10Q: InstaView Stories yana samuwa a na'urorin hannu?

HomePage.faq11A: Abun ciki na iya rashin samuwa saboda bayanin martaba na sirri ne, Labarin ya ƙare, an cire abun cikin, ko an ƙuntata samun Instagram a fasaha.
